objective: Score only confirmed eligible jobs automatically; retrieve missing JD safely; cache semantic extraction and deterministic scores; allow on-demand unconfirmed job evaluation; enforce cost limits and terminal UI states.
forbidden_changes: execute migration on production database without separate authorization
acceptance: No AI call when cached analysis is current
No automatic AI calls for nonconfirmed jobs
JD fetch through cache then source API then safe public HTML
Manual pending job evaluation is user-triggered
Terminal UI state for every attempted evaluation
Backend-side spend reservation/limit and request logging
deployment: No deploy or merge without explicit approval
